events.why_reproducible: HF datasets Arrow caches (hotpot_qa, oasst2, squad_v2, trivia_qa, xlam, dolly). Rebuilt by re-running the builders in scripts/data/, which fetch at pinned revisions; every corpus this project uses is already materialized under artifacts/. No test calls load_dataset.
HF Xet content-addressed transfer chunk cache. Pure download accelerator; recreated by any Hub transfer.
pre-commit hook environments. Recreated by `pre-commit install`/run.
pip wheel cache. Recreated by any pip/uv install.
pytest scratch from six retained suite runs. Ephemeral by construction and recreated by any run.
events.note: Found because the capacity gate FAILED AGAIN 20 minutes after passing: the full suite run between the two checks had consumed 4.8 GB of /tmp, which is on the same filesystem. This is precisely the phenomenon the measured 6 GiB ckpt-store margin exists for, observed live.

free_space_is_volatile: A full-suite run consumes ~4.7 GiB of /tmp scratch on this single-filesystem box, so free space measured before a suite run does not describe the state after one. The launcher re-runs ckpt_store_capacity_gate itself before creating a pod, which is the protection that matters.
